title: crypto2dev: RSA sign/verify/keygen callbacks
description: Implement CryptoCb handlers for RSA operations using KEY fds. Sign: retrieve KEY fd from key->devCtx, call DO_SIGN ioctl with pre-hashed digest (wolfSSL passes digest, not raw message), read DER signature. Verify: retrieve KEY fd from key->devCtx, call DO_VERIFY ioctl, check for -EBADMSG (invalid sig). Keygen: open fd, KEY_GENERATE('rsa-2048' or 'rsa-4096'), read public key, populate RsaKey. Key import: on WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_SETKEY for RSA, open fd, write PKCS#8 key, KEY_IMPORT. Key free: close fd, zero devCtx.
notes: RSA private key is PKCS#8 DER format for KEY_IMPORT. DO_SIGN takes pre-hashed digest — wolfSSL already hashes before calling CryptoCb (confirmed). With WOLF_CRYPTO_CB_RSA_PAD enabled, RsaPadding struct provides hash algo, pad type (PKCS1v15 vs PSS), MGF, salt length — pass hash_algo string to DO_SIGN. RSA-2048 and RSA-4096 only (what crypto2dev supports).
